# H2ODB — Count

```{tags} reference, query-template, h2odb
```

> [H2ODB](../../h2odb.md) benchmark · [all H2ODB queries](index.md)

Basic COUNT(*) full table scan

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM trips
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def q1_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """Q1: COUNT(*)."""
    trips = ctx.get_table("trips")
    col = ctx.col
    return trips.select(col("vendor_id").count().alias("count"))
```
